connects_to.notes: The MPU6886's INT pin shares this net. IRQ is open drain, active low. Bench, 2026-11-17: with the AXP192's IRQs masked and cleared and the MPU6886's INT released, GPIO35 (no internal pull) reads high, so R2 is fitted; an AXP192 IRQ latch left set holds the net low until it is cleared.
PWROK holds the ESP32 in reset until the AXP192's outputs are up.
N_VBUSEN low lets IPSOUT take power from VBUS; high stops it. The pull-down keeps VBUS selected until GPIO27 drives it.
The vendor limits VBUS_VIN and VBUS_USB to 4.8 to 5.5 V; on VBUS the AXP192 charges the internal battery.
C3 (10 µF) on the battery line; TS (pin 37) is tied to GND.
C15 (1 µF) on LDO2, C20 (1 µF) on LDO3.

components.notes: Vendor rail table: LDOio0 microphone, LDO1 RTC, LDO2 TFT backlight, LDO3 TFT IC, DC-DC1 ESP32/3.3 V and MPU6886, IPSOUT 5 V Grove. The schematic draws the 5 V Grove through the SGM6603 boost (EXTEN), which IPSOUT feeds. N_OE (pin 4) is tied to GND (outputs on), BIAS has R5 200 kΩ to GND, VREF and VINT carry C16 and C10 (1 µF), and APS carries C13 (220 nF) on IPSOUT. IPSOUT is decoupled by C24, C30 (100 nF), C23 (10 µF) and CX2 (10 µF / 6.3 V). Current power key behavior (vendor): a single click powers on or resets, a double click powers off.

connects_to.notes: The RTC interrupt is coupled to the power key net, not to an ESP32 GPIO. The vendor's change log for v1.1 (2021-12) reads "Added sleep and wake-up functions". Bench, 2026-11-17: GPIO35 stays high with INT asserted (INT does not reach it); each RTC countdown with the timer interrupt on makes the AXP192 latch a power-key short press, and on a build that powers the board off at the AXP192 an RTC countdown powered it back on after about 19.4 s and 28.7 s (a power-on reset, USB connected; on battery alone not run).

notes: Wiring and passive values come from the vendor's K016-P schematic (one Altium page, exported 2025-11-04), read at the Wayback Machine because the vendor's file host did not answer on 2026-11-16. Rail names follow the schematic: VESP_3V3 (AXP192 DCDC1), IPSOUT (the AXP192 system rail), RTC_VDD (LDO1), LCD_BL_VCC (LDO2), LCD_LOGIC_VCC (LDO3), MIC_VCC (LDOio0), EXT_VDD (the SGM6603 5 V output), VBUS_USB and VBUS_VIN. The schematic draws the VDDA3P3 (pin 4) and VDD3P3_RTC (pin 19) supply lines of the ESP32-PICO-D4 with crossing hops onto the 3.3 V bus, and its net list keeps those two pins apart from VESP_3V3; this file does not record them as connected. Pin 19 is certainly supplied (the board boots from its in-package flash, fed through VDD_SDIO from VDD3P3_RTC); which rail feeds it has not been measured.
